project.title: The Pudding: Colorism in High Fashion

why: A strong digital editorial reference for making methodology, evidence, and narrative feel like one reading experience through sequenced visuals, clear authorship, and paced explanation.

compositions.title: Editorial claim before method
compositions.study: The opener establishes the cultural question before the article introduces calculation and methodology.
compositions.reuse: Use when a data story needs an emotional reading path before technical evidence appears.

compositions.title: Method as visual narrative
compositions.study: Process steps are explained with visuals so readers understand how the evidence is constructed.
compositions.reuse: Show the method in small visual increments instead of hiding it in a footnote.

assets.notes: Captions and annotations carry trust by explaining what each visual means.
assets.reuse: Pair every quantitative visual with a concise explanation of source, measure, or limitation.

assets.notes: Images are part of the evidence, not generic editorial decoration.
assets.reuse: Use licensed or original visual datasets and keep source boundaries explicit.

motion.title: Scrollytelling evidence reveal
motion.notes: Long-form progression can reveal argument, process, and result in sequence.
motion.fallback: A static stacked layout should preserve the same evidence order.

interactions.title: Reader-controlled proof path
interactions.study: The article supports deeper reading through methods and linked evidence.
interactions.reuse: Offer method/detail exits without interrupting the main narrative.

implementation.notes: Useful for data essays, annual reports, research explainers, and investigative product stories.
